note: This file records why and how the K2 workflow_sha256 pin changed. It documents the change; it does not itself ratify or approve anything. The repository's precedent for a K2-style byte-hash refresh (e.g. commits 006bbf58b 'Repair Korea market signal source-owner pins' and 3b60d5aea 'fix: refresh Korea source owner integrity pins') is a plain pin-value edit with no separate approval record, because the registry only pins byte-identity and owner metadata -- not a market policy, threshold, or authority value. This record exists anyway, per an explicit request to record the reason and stop short of claiming approval.
reason: remove raw KRX rows from public artifact (licensing)
problem: korea-market-signals.yml uploaded artifact/source-capture (original per-symbol KOSPI/KOSDAQ pykrx/KRX response bytes) as a public actions/upload-artifact bundle with 30-day retention, downloadable by any repository reader. docs/krx_investable_registry_contract.md 'Distribution boundary' and config/krx_*_contract.json cite KRX_OPEN_API_TERMS_RESTRICT_THIRD_PARTY_PROVISION_AND_REDISTRIBUTION_RIGHTS_ARE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: raw KRX responses and per-symbol rows are private-only evidence.
fix: Added a 'Strip raw KRX response bytes before public artifact upload' step to .github/workflows/korea-market-signals.yml that removes artifact/source-capture/responses (the raw provider bytes) before the actions/upload-artifact step, while keeping artifact/source-capture/manifest.json (hashes, byte lengths, capture times, status -- no raw values) and every other already-aggregate file the artifact carries (KR_PAPER_REFERENCE_CANDIDATE.json, PYKRX_PROBE.json, the observation packets). The producer script and its local capture-then-hash-bind flow are unchanged; only what leaves the runner in the public artifact changes.
consumer_check: No merged workflow downloads or requires artifact/source-capture/responses from this artifact. The only in-flight consumer is PR #770 (kr-paper-runtime-daily-publish.yml, artifact mode, not yet merged), whose own commit-boundary step already asserts its downloaded bundle's diff carries no responses/ or source-capture/ path -- it only ever persists the already-aggregate paths. Removing raw bytes from new runs' public artifacts does not remove anything that mode uses; it only makes raw-bundle re-validation (if ever added) unavailable for artifact runs produced after this change. Capture mode (PR #770's own direct producer run) is unaffected -- it never reads this workflow's artifact.
